notes: Latency model (fitted and verified on this core): the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 10 when the quotient is 0, 12 when |dividend| < |divisor|, otherwise 13 + floor(bits(quotient)/4) plus 1 for the remainder path. Extremes: min 10 (dividend 0), max 29 for du lanes (quotient width 64 bits, dividend 0xffffffffffffffff, divisor 1). Verified points: vdiv.w 22, xvdiv.w 21, vdiv.du 28, xvdiv.du 27, xvdiv.d 26, xvmod.d 27 (q62), 19 (q30), 12 (q1), 10 (power-of-two divisor), 8 (dividend 0). The scalar divider is a different unit and reaches 38-39 cycles. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
